claims.summary: A single local drive event injected at node_00 that fans out through a 2x2 mesh to all twelve output drive endpoints.
claims.subject: flow_002_IONetwork_i_driveLocal_00
claims.explanation: The flow starts at i_driveLocal_00 into node_00. Node_00 can route the event to its local, south, and west outputs, and also to node_01 via w_drive00201 and to node_10 via w_drive00210. From node_01 and node_10, the event can propagate to node_11 via w_drive01211 and w_drive10211 respectively. Each node can also output to its local, north, south, east, and west ports, resulting in all twelve o_drive_* endpoints being reachable.

claims.subject: node_01, node_10, node_11
claims.summary: Intermediate and final branching nodes that propagate the event to all output endpoints.
claims.explanation: node_01 receives the event from node_00 via w_drive00201 and can output to its local, north, and west ports, and forward to node_11 via w_drive01211. node_10 receives the event from node_00 via w_drive00210 and can output to its east, local, and south ports, and forward to node_11 via w_drive10211. node_11 receives the event from node_01 and node_10 and can output to its east, local, and north ports. Together, they ensure the event reaches all twelve output endpoints.
